executionTriggerModel.summary: Permissionless submission of a KMS/authority-signed ExecutionIntent to Program.executeLiquidityBuilding. No on-chain scheduler, no UI execute button, no market auto-fire.

triggers.ownerActivate: eligibility only — sets lifecycle Active; does not swap/LP
triggers.indexerCron: inventory sync only (/api/indexer/liquidity-building/run) — does not execute
triggers.epochDurationSeconds: constraint / one-exec-per-epoch window — not a timer
triggers.autonomousLoop: library stub only — Disabled KMS + Disabled relay
triggers.permissionlessRelayer: designed: any msg.sender with valid signature — not provisioned

lifecycle: Off-chain: observe eligible net-buy flow + build ExecutionIntent
Off-chain: sign intent with Authorizer signingAuthority (KMS)
Swap project token for exact quote via Melega router
Settle 10% success fee via FeeSink → FeeReceiver
Add liquidity with remaining quote + project token; mint LP to lpRecipient
Update remainingBudget / accounting / latestExecution; emit ExecutionCompleted
